note: W3 explicit price input (07): net-cost rankings are computed under a PINNED priceModelVersion; a report must state which version it used. Every entry carries a source + verified status — null prices are UNVERIFIED and are NEVER silently substituted (0.0 is an observed free tier, null is 'we do not know'). v0 models cached-read and uncached-input only: xCABI v0 call.meta records estimated hit/miss tokens, not cache-write, so the write premium is UNMODELED — the field exists for v1 and stays null until the trace schema carries it. v2 (2026-11-06): the owner's catalogue export is added under `catalogue`; the v1 `providers` block is unchanged. The export carries no cache-read price, so `usdPer1mCachedRead` is null for every catalogue entry — unknown, never substituted. Prices are owner-supplied, not web-verified here.
